title: Opengear Forges Distribution Agreement with Ingram Micro Spain
summary: Building on Ingram Micro’s successful relationship with Opengear in the U.S., Ingram Micro Spain will now distribute Opengear’s market-leading remote-management technology to customers in Spain.
body_markdown: Building on Ingram Micro’s successful relationship with Opengear in the U.S., Ingram Micro Spain will now distribute Opengear’s market-leading remote-management technology to customers in Spain.
